accuracy: One record is correct only when every water depth, the period and phase (or no candidate), or every cumulative bowling score and pending marker matches the reference.
astronomy: Measure exact recovery of the injected period and phase separately from exact agreement with the declared detector. Report detections on uninjected series and misses or period/phase mismatches on injected series. Generator metadata is withheld from both model input and scoring oracle.
timing: Report median synchronized forward time and all three repeats over 64 pre-encoded GPU-resident records in batches of eight, after a warm-up. Encoding, transfers, scoring and disk I/O are outside the timer.
